subject: Haaland's stoppage-time VAR-awarded penalty sends Norway past Denmark into Nations League quarter-finals
title: Haaland's late penalty sends Norway through

lines.vo: Two down, and then VAR met Erling Haaland.
lines.footage: Denmark goals montage, Hojlund and Hojbjerg, then VAR review graphic

lines.vo: Norway beat Denmark 3-2 and are into the Nations League quarter-finals. The winner was a stoppage-time penalty.
Denmark led 2-0 inside fifteen minutes. Odegaard equalised in the eighty-seventh minute. Denmark had a lovely quarter of an hour.
lines.footage: Odegaard goal clip, Norway bench reaction

lines.vo: VAR reviewed a handball by Joachim Andersen in stoppage time. Haaland scored the penalty.
lines.footage: VAR review graphic, Haaland penalty slow motion

lines.vo: He then tore off his shirt in celebration and was booked for it. A yellow card for a shirt. Worth it, he might say.
lines.footage: Haaland celebration clip, referee with yellow card

lines.vo: Sixty-eight international goals in sixty-one games, and twenty-five in the Nations League, a record. Over a goal a game. The shirt was just keeping up.
